notes: LIT = THE LOAD SWITCH IS DELIVERING: it hangs on the LT1641's output (UMBILICAL_POS12), so it goes dark with the toggle off and when the -1 latches on a fault - the one thing the panel has to say. It does not say the instrument is plugged in; that is the instrument's to report. Lite-On LTL-4231N, LCSC C125082. ITS FLANGE IS D3.2, THE SAME AS THE PANEL HOLE [ds LITEON-LTL-4231N-3MM-GREEN-DIFFUSED.pdf p.2], so it does not stop against the panel: it needs MECH-LED-BEZEL-MOD

About 4.5 mA from the load switch's output (UMBILICAL_POS12), which reaches the jack board on J-B2B-MOD pin 19. Not from the analog +12 V: that rail is live whenever the rack is, so the LED could not show a latch
